opening.argument: The video is presented as an official music release connected to the film Vivegam, with named performers and production figures, rather than as a financial opportunity. Its description calls it “the official video of #SURVIVA by Anirudh featuring Yogi B and Mali Manoj from the massive #VIVEGAM,” while the sampled frames show cinematic scenes involving groups gathered around a campfire and people in military-style clothing inside a vehicle. The accompanying “Subscribe- Vevo” request is ordinary audience engagement and contains no payment condition, investment pathway, credential request, private-data collection, money-making promise, or deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: Proudly presenting the official video of #SURVIVA by Anirudh featuring Yogi B and Mali Manoj from the massive #VIVEGAM
